headlines.usage_rules: Use for H1-H3. Apply tracking-tight for H1/H2.

body_and_ui.usage_rules: Use for paragraphs, labels, small text. Keep leading-relaxed.

colors.strategy: Warm neutral base with signature deep amber/terracotta accent. No excessive gold/black.
rules: Use #F9F8F6 (Ivory) as main background instead of pure white.
Use #2C2C2B (Soft Charcoal) for text instead of pure black.
Accent colors (#B85B24) should be used sparingly for primary CTAs and active states.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA.

spacing_and_grids.spacing_system: Consistent 8px scaling (Tailwind defaults). Use generous padding (p-8, p-12, p-16) to create a boutique gallery feel.
spacing_and_grids.layout_mode: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol / High Density but with editorial breathing room.
rules: Use negative space aggressively to highlight product imagery.
Grid children must be direct children. Use align-items: start to prevent default stretch where appropriate.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass variant: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80. Do NOT use completely transparent headers.
surfaces.cards: Flat solid background with 1px delicate border (border-[#E5E3DC]). No default drop shadows.
surfaces.images: Use subtle overlay max bg-black/20 for hero if text is on top, or gradient to maintain image clarity.

motion.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-105) for images, opacity shifts for text links. Transition duration 300ms ease-out.
motion.scroll: Fade-in and slight translate-y-4 using framer-motion.
motion.rules: No universal `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-opacity`, `transition-transform`.

hero.layout: Full-bleed lifestyle image or video with center or left aligned editorial text.
hero.overlay: bg-black/30 or gradient to ensure text readability.
hero.cta: Solid accent color button or transparent button with 1px border. Pill-shaped or slight rounding.

navigation.layout: Sticky header (z-50). Logo center, links left/right or Logo left, links center, icons right.
navigation.mobile: Hamburger menu opening a full-screen or slide-out menu.

product_card.layout: Image top (aspect-[4/5] or 1:1), text bottom. Left-aligned text.
product_card.image: Fill container, object-cover. On hover, subtle scale (scale-105).
product_card.details: Title in Cormorant Garamond, price in Outfit. No card border/shadow unless strictly necessary.

category_tile.layout: Square or tall rectangle with background image and text overlay at bottom.
category_tile.typography: H3 size text, tracking-tight, white text with text-shadow for contrast.

footer.layout: Dark background (#2C2C2B) with light text (#F9F8F6) to create contrast shift.
footer.elements: Newsletter signup, brand story strip, links.

libraries_and_tools.icons: lucide-react for UI icons (user, cart, search, chevron).
libraries_and_tools.motion: framer-motion for scroll reveal and page transitions.
libraries_and_tools.ui_components: shadcn/ui for complex interactive elements (Select, Dialog, Tabs). Customize heavily to remove 'Vercel-look'.
libraries_and_tools.3d_and_advanced: Not strictly necessary for the core MVP unless visualizing lighting spread, but framer-motion is sufficient for the 'boutique' feel.

accessibility: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
Use appropriate aria-labels for icon-only buttons.

hero_living_room.description: Luxury living room interior - perfect for hero section

category_chandelier.description: Modern chandelier over dining table - category image

category_pendant.description: Bedroom warm pendant light - category image

category_wall_sconce.description: Modern circular wall sconce - category image

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all files. DO NOT output .tsx files.
Implement the pages using React and Tailwind CSS.
Install necessary fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Outfit) via Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
Use 'react-router-dom' for page navigation (Home, Categories, PDP, Cart, Checkout, etc).
Ensure the hero section does NOT use a completely transparent header; use glassmorphism.
Do not use generic drop shadows on cards; use the flat editorial style with generous spacing.
Build Shadcn components (Select, Dialog, Tabs) in standard .js and remove default Vercel-look by applying the brand's Ivory/Charcoal palette and Outfit font.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (p-8, p-12).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
